highlights.description: Server lifecycle helpers (`ServerReachable`, `StartServer`, `EnsureServer`) — start or reuse a local `dolt sql-server`, the shared pattern from visionstudio and omniroadmap
`CreateDatabase` plus commit operations (`HasUncommittedChanges`, `AddAll`, `Commit`, `CommitAll`) for wrapping sync runs in a Dolt commit
DSN helpers (`LocalDSN`, `EnsureParseTime`, `SplitDSN`) — pure string helpers for go-sql-driver DSNs pointed at a dolt sql-server, no driver dependency added

added.description: `ServerReachable(addr)` probes a TCP address; `StartServer(dataDir, port)` launches `dolt sql-server` over a data directory and waits for readiness, caller owns the returned process; `EnsureServer(dataDir, port)` ensures one is serving, launching it detached if not — the shared local-server pattern from visionstudio and omniroadmap. Tests run against a real dolt server, skipping when the binary is absent
`CreateDatabase(ctx, db, name)` runs `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS` over a server-wide connection

`Client.HasUncommittedChanges`, `Client.AddAll`, `Client.Commit`, `Client.CommitAll` — stage and commit working-set changes via `dolt_status`, `DOLT_ADD`, and `DOLT_COMMIT` (message bound as a parameter so it may contain any characters); `CommitAll` is a no-op on a clean working set, the pattern apps use to wrap sync runs
`LocalDSN(port, database)`, `EnsureParseTime(dsn)`, `SplitDSN(dsn)` — build the conventional local DSN, append `parseTime=true` for Ent, and split a DSN into its server-wide base and database name

documentation.description: README Library Features table extended with server lifecycle, DSN, and commit helpers, plus an application store pattern example (ensure server, create database, connect, wrap writes in a Dolt commit)

highlights.description: Fixed Client.Pull, which errored on every call since v0.1.0 — CALL DOLT_PULL returns a 3-column result the shared call() helper couldn't scan

fixed.description: Client.Pull now scans DOLT_PULL's actual (fast_forward, conflicts, message) result directly instead of assuming the 1-or-2-column shape shared by every other stored procedure; verified against a real dolt sql-server reproducing true history divergence

breaking.description: Client.Pull's return type changes from (string, error) to (*PullResult, error), exposing FastForward and Conflicts alongside the status message; there is no compatible old signature to preserve since every prior call errored unconditionally

highlights.description: SQL-wire `Client` for remotes, push/pull/fetch, and active branch — zero added driver dependencies, the caller supplies the `*sql.DB`
CLI-exec bootstrap (`Clone`, `InitDir`) and backup (`BackupAdd`, `BackupSync`, `BackupRestore`) operations for the cold path

added.description: `New(db *sql.DB) *Client` wraps an existing connection to a `dolt sql-server`
`Client.RemoteAdd`, `Client.RemoteRemove`, `Client.Remotes` — register, remove, and list configured remotes via `CALL DOLT_REMOTE(...)`
`Client.Push`, `Client.Pull`, `Client.Fetch` — sync against a remote via `CALL DOLT_PUSH`/`DOLT_PULL`/`DOLT_FETCH`
`Client.ActiveBranch` — the connection's active branch via `SELECT active_branch()`
Argument validation (`quotable`) rejects characters that could escape a single-quoted SQL literal
`Clone(ctx, remoteURL, dir)` and `InitDir(ctx, dir, name, email)` — CLI-exec bootstrap operations for when no server exists yet
`Available()` reports whether the `dolt` CLI is on `PATH`
`BackupAdd`, `BackupSync`, `BackupRestore` — named backup targets, snapshot/sync, and restore; no `DOLT_BACKUP` stored procedure exists, so these are CLI-exec only

documentation.description: README with installation, usage examples, and a full API reference table
MkDocs site (mirroring gogit's structure) with a Releases section for version history
README badges for CI, lint, SAST, godoc, MkDocs, visualization, and license status

build.description: Shared CI workflows: Go CI (test matrix across Linux/macOS/Windows), Go Lint (golangci-lint), Go SAST (CodeQL), and Dependabot config
.gitignore for mkdocs build output and local env files

internal.description: Removed the unused `status` result from `Client.call` (golangci-lint unparam) — every caller already relied on `call` turning a nonzero status into an error internally
